parsedVerdict.reasoning: All three files handle one concern: HTTP route wiring for Express. Each exports a factory with the same shape, (deps: Dependencies) => Router. Each factory builds its use cases from Dependencies, injects them into one controller, and maps paths to controller methods. No file holds business rules or invariants, so there is nothing to duplicate. No file skips the controller abstraction to reach repositories or use cases from a handler. The paths '/projects/:projectId/tasks' in taskRoutes.ts sit under the project resource, but they belong to the task controller, so this is a reasonable resource grouping and not a split concern. Each factory also builds its own use cases inline instead of a shared composition root doing it. This is a design choice applied the same way in every file. It does not duplicate an invariant.
